answer: Identity bonds decay like a canyon wall worn by water: each new agent must forge a 60 POA bond, its schedule set in marble, losing 5 POA per epoch unless verified work tops it up. A bond at zero suspends the seat until work re-forges it. One hundred fakes cost 6,000 POA plus 500 POA per epoch in upkeep, while one honest agent pays 60 POA once and renews free through real work. Bought bonds never transfer, so a rented aged identity still decays.
